en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 405 - It is narrated by Himyari from his father from Ja’far bin Muhammad Kufi from Ishaq bin Muhammad from Qasim bin Rabi from Ali bin Khattab on the authority of the Muezzin of the red mosque:

I asked Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s), “Is there in the Book of Allah a similitude for the Qaim?” He said: “Yes, the verse of the owner of the donkey, Allah made him die for a hundred years and then raised him up again.”
